lines.trans: Mathias's departure weakens our agency.
It is the opportunity to rethink our work.
I said yes to Charlotte too quickly.
She cannot shoot this dud!
Simply tell her the truth without waiting.
We must first save face.
Everyone expects our downfall.

words.gloss: people, world; tout le monde = everyone

lines.trans: We are going to prove our great strength.
Let's immediately recruit great new talent.
We must also bet on television series.
Let's not sacrifice arthouse cinema!

words.gloss: author, writer; cinéma d'auteur = arthouse cinema

examples.trans: First of all, let's talk about work.

examples.text: Cette agence ne représente que des stars.

meanings.note: une agence artistique = a talent agency

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: J'ai apporté cinq exemplaires des contrats.
examples.trans: I've brought five copies of the contracts.

examples.text: Tu déjeunes aussi avec Dany Boon.
examples.trans: You're also having lunch with Dany Boon.

meanings.note: films with a strong personal style

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.trans: Shall we go to the cinema?

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

meanings.note: dire la vérité à quelqu'un = to tell someone the truth
avant mon départ = before I leave

examples.text: Elle est trop vieille pour le rôle.
examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

meanings.en: face, front; face à = facing, in the face of, confronted with

examples.trans: To look straight in the face.

examples.text: Je dois régler ce problème immédiatement.
examples.trans: I must settle this problem immediately.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Nous devons miser sur les séries.

meanings.note: tout le monde = everyone; il y a du monde = it's crowded
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
before the noun; nouvel before a vowel
c'est l'occasion de = it's a chance to

examples.text: C'est l'occasion de me faire connaître.
examples.trans: It is a chance to get myself known.

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.trans: I can't take it any more.

examples.text: Tu as des projets ce soir?

examples.trans: They try to prove their thesis.

examples.trans: She is not the one who is hiring!

meanings.note: repenser à un souvenir = to think back to a memory

examples.text: Je repense souvent à ce jour.
examples.trans: I often think back to that day.

examples.text: Ne restez pas là à ne rien faire!
examples.trans: Don't just stay there doing nothing!

examples.trans: I'm not going to sacrifice our relationship for a film.

examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route

meanings.note: une série policière = a detective series

tournez le visage = turn your face
